Vermont Artificial Intelligence Laboratory

Machine learning.
A world of applications.

We study machine learning at the intersection of theory and application, with a focus on visual geo-localization and geospatial understanding. Our interdisciplinary collaborations extend to medicine, transportation, energy, and communications.
